camel_example: aliyun csas CreatePrivateAccessApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --BrowserAccessStatus Disabled --PortRanges.1.Begin 80 --Description '这是一条内网访问应用' --UnauthorizedAccessConfig 'example-string' --AddressGroups.1 'example-string' --PortRanges.1.End 81 --Name private_access_application_name --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --L7ProxyDomainCustom 'app1.example.com' --L7Config 'example-string' --L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix 'app-sample' --ConfigMode 'example-string' --Addresses.1 '192.168.0.0/16' --Protocol All --method POST --force
description_en: Creates an internal-facing access application under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 创建当前阿里云账号下内网访问应用
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-private-access-application --name private_access_application_name --description '这是一条内网访问应用' --addresses 192.168.0.0/16 --port-ranges Begin=80 End=81 --protocol All --status Enabled --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --browser-access-status Disabled --l7-proxy-domain-automatic-prefix app-sample --l7-proxy-domain-custom app1.example.com --l7-config example-string --config-mode example-string --address-groups '["example-string"]' --unauthorized-access-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateAccessApplication

parameters.help_en: The name of the internal-facing access application. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问应用
parameters.help_en: The description of the internal-facing access application. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The collection of internal-facing access application addresses. You can specify up to 1000 addresses
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用地址集合。最多可输入1000个内网访问应用地址
parameters.name: addresses

fields.help_en: The start port. The value must be less than or equal to the end port
fields.help_zh: 起始端口。小于等于结束端口
fields.name: begin

fields.help_en: The end port. The value must be greater than or equal to the start port
fields.help_zh: 结束端口。大于等于起始端口
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The collection of port ranges for the internal-facing access application. You can specify up to 65535 port ranges. Port ranges cannot overlap or be duplicated
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用端口范围集合。最多可输入65535个端口范围。多个端口范围不可重复或重叠
parameters.name: port_ranges

parameters.help_en:
The protocol of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
All: all protocols.
TCP
UDP
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用协议。取值：
All：全部。
TCP
UDP
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

parameters.help_en: The collection of internal-facing access tag IDs. You can associate up to 6 custom-type internal-facing access tags with each application

parameters.help_en:
The browser access status of the internal-facing access application. After this feature is enabled, you can access internal applications in a clientless manner. Default value: Disabled. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用状态，开启后可以通过无端方式访问内网应用。默认值为Disabled。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
